title: Considering Individual Differences and the Importance of the Example in Tarbiyah

text_simplified: Individual differences among children must be considered in tarbiyah. The older brother is disciplined more strictly if he errs because he is a role model, while the girl may be disciplined less due to the delicacy of her body. Younger children should also respect their older brother. The father must be a good example (uswah hasanah) for his children. Tarbiyah relies on the good example that the child feels from a young age and needs in every stage of their life.
